about: The introitus of the formulary “Commemoration of All the Faithful Departed — Mass I” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Eternal rest give to them, O Lord; and let perpetual light shine upon them. To You we owe our hymn of praise, O God, in Sion; to You must vows be fulfilled in Jerusalem. Hear my prayer; to You all flesh must come. Eternal rest give to them, O Lord; and let perpetual light shine upon them.
